column1: Stumbling on Happiness|2006|0|0||7,5,7,7,8,8,3,9,9,8|Daniel Gilbert|Affective forecasting connects memory, simulation and decision errors. Experiments and examples add distinctions; broad popular exposition limits specialist depth. Source reader report plus catalog synopsis; density confidence low.

Between Us: How Cultures Create Emotions|2022|0|0||8,6,7,7,8,8,3,9,8,8|Batja Mesquita|Cross-cultural comparisons challenge the assumption that emotions have identical meanings everywhere; useful for institutions and cooperation. Evidence is descriptive and interpretive rather than a universal causal model.

China’s World View|2024|10|10||6,8,7,7,7,7,7,8,8,7|David Daokui Li|Explains Chinese economic governance, bureaucracy and diplomacy from an informed insider position. Institutional links are useful; access and allegiance must not be mistaken for independent validation. No serious veto established from the inspected report.

Arabs|2019|0|0||9,8,7,7,8,9,5,9,9,9|Tim Mackintosh-Smith|Language, trade, political fragmentation and culture connect across three millennia. Comparative historical detail supplies learning beyond a repeated thesis; no single central period endpoint.

The Vagabond’s Way|2022|0|10||6,3,4,3,6,8,1,7,8,7|Rolf Potts|Daily reflections offer portable attitudes toward travel and uncertainty. Quotation and inspirational form limit mechanisms and cumulative argument; low direct fit does not exclude it.

How Religion Evolved|2022|0|0||7,7,7,8,8,8,4,9,8,8|Robin Dunbar|Connects social bonding, group size, ritual and cognitive evolution. Evolutionary reconstructions need caution; religion is an analytical subject rather than asserted authority.

Nothing & Everything|2017|0|10||4,3,4,3,4,6,1,3,6,5|Val N. Tine|Nihilistic reflections challenge attachment to beliefs but provide little evidential structure. The reader report identifies an unsatisfactory second half, lowering whole-book learning yield. Philosophical stance alone is not an extremism veto.

You Look Like a Thing and I Love You|2019|0|0||8,6,8,8,8,8,9,8,9,8|Janelle Shane|Small AI experiments expose specification failure, dataset bias and unexpected optimization. Humorous examples make distinct failure modes memorable; introductory depth limits the expert payoff.

City of Gold: Dubai|2009|10|0|2009|8,8,7,7,8,8,6,8,9,8|Jim Krane|Connects ports, capital, migration, real estate and state direction through Dubai's growth. A city-centered narrative triggers T11; infrastructure and development are the main mechanism, not politics alone.

Relationship Handbook|1991|0|0||5,3,5,4,6,7,1,6,7,6|George Pransky|Mood-dependent interpretation and communication offer a portable interpersonal heuristic. Counseling observations provide limited causal evidence; substantial personal advice gives low domain fit.

Happy|2016|0|10||7,5,6,5,7,9,2,6,9,8|Derren Brown|Connects Stoic ideas, desire and narrative evaluation of experience. The comparative philosophical cases add learning, though the center is personal well-being rather than systems or technology.

Au Contraire: Figuring Out the French|2001|10|0||7,6,6,6,7,8,3,7,8,7|Gilles Asselin; Ruth Mastron|Explains cultural assumptions behind French behavior and institutions. Comparisons support cross-cultural transfer, but national generalizations and a single-country focus limit confidence and fit.

The Subtle Art of Not Giving a Fuck|2016|0|10||5,3,5,4,6,7,1,4,8,5|Mark Manson|Reframes limits, values and responsibility through personal examples. The transferable core survives the provocative style; anecdotal evidence and recurring motivational framing lower integrity and density estimates.

Too Soon Old, Too Late Smart|2004|0|0||6,3,4,4,6,8,1,7,8,7|Gordon Livingston|Clinical experience supplies concise distinctions about expectations and relationships. General lessons exist, so V3 is not established; personal counsel provides little strategic or technical integration.

Cows, Pigs, Wars, and Witches|1974|0|0||6,8,7,8,8,8,4,9,8,7|Marvin Harris|Material incentives and ecological constraints connect cultural practices across societies. Explanatory ambition is strong; functional explanations can outrun direct causal evidence. Multiple historical cases do not define one central period.

The Entrepreneur Roller Coaster|2015|0|0||4,4,5,3,4,5,3,5,8,5|Darren Hardy|Motivational stories encourage persistence, selling and recruitment. Some transferable business advice remains, but selected success examples and exhortation give low causal and density scores.

The Willpower Instinct|2012|0|0||6,5,6,6,7,7,2,8,8,7|Kelly McGonigal|Connects attention, temptation, stress and self-regulation with practical exercises. Older willpower research is not uniformly secure; no claim of fully replicated findings. Exercises add application but reduce priority for this reader.

Turning Pro|2012|0|0||4,2,4,2,4,7,1,5,8,5|Steven Pressfield|A hobby-to-profession distinction and resistance heuristic offer some transfer. The source explicitly values repeated motivational reinforcement; this is limited new learning across the whole book.

Do the Work|2011|0|0||4,2,4,2,4,7,1,5,8,5|Steven Pressfield|Encourages starting and finishing creative work through a resistance metaphor. A small reusable heuristic prevents a no-payload veto, but evidence, mechanisms and distinct learning remain thin.

The Happiness Hypothesis|2006|0|10||7,7,7,7,8,8,3,9,9,8|Jonathan Haidt|Compares philosophical traditions with psychological research on emotion, reasoning and flourishing. Distinct comparisons add value; psychological generalizations and normative conclusions need separate scrutiny.

The Time Paradox|2008|0|0||6,5,6,6,6,7,2,8,8,7|Philip Zimbardo; John Boyd|Time perspective supplies a useful distinction between present, past and future orientation. Broad typologies and advice are less secure than direct observations; repeated application limits density.

The Paradox of Choice - Why More is Less|2004|0|0||6,5,7,7,7,8,3,8,8,7|Barry Schwartz|Explains search costs, regret and maximizing behavior. Choice overload is conditional rather than universal; the central distinction transfers to product design and decisions with appropriate limits.

Private Revolutions|2024|10|0|2023|8,7,5,6,8,8,3,8,9,8|Yuan Yang|Four women's lives connect education, work, migration and Chinese economic change. Comparative trajectories add social knowledge, but individual cases do not identify general causal effects. T11 applies to the country-centered account.

Tribal|2024|0|0||7,7,7,7,7,7,4,9,8,7|Michael Morris|Links cultural psychology, social learning and institutional change. Group-based mechanisms have broad application; broad synthesis and recent framing call for caution about generality.

Argumentative Indian|2005|10|10||8,7,6,6,8,9,3,10,8,9|Amartya Sen|Historical essays connect pluralism, public reasoning and Indian institutions. Distinct intellectual cases add learning; national political-cultural scope triggers both thematic deductions without implying ideological capture.

Mathematica|2022|0|0||7,6,8,7,8,9,9,9,8,8|David Bessis|Explains mathematical intuition, visualization and the gap between experience and formal language. A reflective account of mathematical thinking rather than a technical curriculum; personal method is not universal proof. Original French publication predates the English translation.

This Is Strategy|2024|0|0||6,7,7,6,7,7,5,7,8,7|Seth Godin|Short observations connect constraints, incentives, time horizons and market choices. Breadth supports reuse, while fragmented presentation supplies less causal demonstration than a sustained case analysis.

Dawn of Eurasia|2018|0|10||7,8,7,7,7,7,7,8,8,8|Bruno Maçães|Travel and geopolitical interpretation connect infrastructure, borders, trade and state ambition. The synthesis transfers, but future regional integration is an argument rather than an established outcome.

The Religious Case Against Belief|2008|0|10||6,5,6,5,7,8,2,8,8,7|James P. Carse|Distinguishes inquiry from fixed belief and examines how identities sustain conflict. A philosophical argument about religion, not doctrine presented as authoritative truth; historical examples do not by themselves prove the proposed distinction.

Pragmatism|1907|0|10||8,5,7,6,8,10,3,10,7,9|William James|Lectures connect truth, practical consequences and pluralism. Argumentative distinctions remain useful despite old prose; philosophy is central and the original-publication deduction reaches its cap.

The Biggest Bluff|2020|0|0||8,6,8,7,8,8,5,8,9,8|Maria Konnikova|Poker learning separates decision quality from realized outcomes and exposes emotional responses to risk. The memoir adds concrete boundary conditions; strategic uncertainty is the main transferable payload.

Philosophy: a Complete Introduction|2014|0|10||7,5,6,5,8,9,2,8,9,8|Sharon Kaye|Explanatory survey of major arguments and philosophers, not a specialist proof curriculum. Broad distinctions and clear examples support learning; depth and technical fit remain limited.

The Minimalist Entrepreneur|2021|0|0||6,6,7,6,7,7,5,7,8,7|Sahil Lavingia|Community, small experiments and revenue discipline form a coherent small-business strategy. Firsthand experience is useful but does not establish universal startup success conditions.

How to Live on 24 Hours a Day|1908|0|0||6,3,5,3,7,9,1,6,8,8|Arnold Bennett|Concise reflections distinguish available time from chosen priorities. Portable attention heuristics remain, but the personal-improvement focus offers little systems or technical depth.

How to Think More Effectively|2020|0|10||6,4,6,4,7,8,2,5,8,7|The School of Life|Short philosophical distinctions concern attention, envy, reflection and listening. Varied applications provide modest learning without substantial evidence or mechanism development.

All I Really Need to Know I Learned in Kindergarten|1986|0|0||6,2,3,2,5,8,1,5,9,8|Robert Fulghum|Personal essays turn ordinary experiences into general ethical reminders. Memorable narration is stronger than causal explanation; low transfer is not proven absent, so the book remains scored.

The Practice|2020|0|0||5,3,5,3,5,7,2,6,8,6|Seth Godin|Consistent creative work and feedback supply reusable work habits. The source describes encouragement as the principal benefit, limiting evidence, mechanisms and learning density.

Stillness Is the Key|2019|0|10||6,4,5,4,6,8,1,5,8,7|Ryan Holiday|Examples connect attention, emotional control and deliberate action. Historical personalities illustrate principles rather than establish causation; popular philosophical advice is central.

Everything Is Fucked|2019|0|10||5,5,5,4,6,7,2,4,8,5|Mark Manson|Popular philosophy connects hope, emotion and ethical limits. Accessible examples carry some distinctions, while rhetorical generalizations and uneven argument lower precision and evidence.

Stubborn Attachments|2018|0|10||8,8,8,7,8,9,7,9,8,8|Tyler Cowen|Connects long-run growth, rights and future welfare through an explicit ethical argument. Strong strategic relevance does not erase normative assumptions; philosophy remains central.

Watching the English|2004|10|0||8,6,6,6,8,8,3,8,9,8|Kate Fox|Participant observation compares class signals, conversation rules and everyday institutions. Cases provide distinct cultural learning, while generalization from one national setting limits transfer.

Total Recall|2012|10|10|2011|6,5,5,4,6,7,2,6,8,6|Arnold Schwarzenegger; Peter Petre|Entrepreneurial ambition and career transitions offer lessons, but retrospective self-presentation limits evidence. Celebrity and political career are central; personal detail lowers whole-book yield.

Smartcuts|2014|0|0||5,6,7,5,6,6,4,6,8,6|Shane Snow|Compares routes that bypass conventional career progression. Selection on successful cases limits causal conclusions, though constraints and leverage provide reusable prompts for strategy.

Superhuman by Habit|2014|0|0||5,3,5,4,6,7,1,4,7,6|Tynan|Practical habit formation includes triggers, consistency and recovery after lapses. Personal experience supports examples but little controlled evidence; compact advice has modest distinct payload.

Mindwise|2014|0|0||8,6,8,7,8,8,3,9,8,8|Nicholas Epley|Experiments distinguish actual understanding from confidence in reading other minds. Perspective-taking errors and limits transfer to organizational judgment and cooperation.

The Obstacle Is the Way|2014|0|10||6,4,5,4,6,8,2,5,8,6|Ryan Holiday|Stoic reframing separates controllable actions from circumstances. Repeated exemplary lives motivate the same core principle; causal inference and whole-book learning are limited.

The Antidote|2012|0|10||7,5,6,5,7,8,2,7,9,8|Oliver Burkeman|Contrasts positive thinking with uncertainty, acceptance and negative visualization. Different traditions add distinctions, but reporting and personal interpretation exceed direct empirical testing.

Decisive|2013|0|0||7,6,8,7,8,8,5,7,9,8|Chip Heath; Dan Heath|Widening options, testing assumptions and preparing for error form a reusable decision process. Cases add applications and constraints, with some selective-example risk.
